title: Improving the Efficiency of Subgroup Analysis in Randomized Controlled Trials with TMLE
abstract: arXiv:2605.15483v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Subgroup analyses within randomized controlled trials are often underpowered due to limited sample sizes. We address this challenge by leveraging trial participants outside the subgroup of interest to augment estimation within the subgroup. Specifically, we study two Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimators (TMLEs) that borrow information from non-subgroup participants within the same trial: a TMLE with pooled regression (TMLE-PR) and an Adaptive Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimator (A-TMLE). Both estimators enable information sharing without relying on any external real-world data, thereby capitalizing on key strengths of the trial: most importantly, the protection against bias afforded by the randomized treatment, but also harmonized data collection, and consistent treatment and outcome definitions. translated_title: 使用TMLE提高随机对照试验中亚组分析的效率
translated_abstract: 随机对照试验中的亚组分析常常因样本量有限而导致统计效能不足。我们通过利用目标亚组之外的试验参与者来增强亚组内的估计，从而应对这一挑战。具体而言，我们研究了两种从同一试验中非亚组参与者借入信息的目标最大似然估计量（TMLE）：采用合并回归的TMLE（TMLE-PR）和自适应目标最大似然估计量（A-TMLE）。这两种估计量均能在不依赖任何外部真实世界数据的情况下实现信息共享，从而充分发挥试验本身的关键优势：最重要的是随机化治疗所带来的抗偏倚保护，此外还包括统一协调的数据收集以及一致的治疗与结局定义。本文提出的一般性策略直接推进了包括美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）在内的关键监管机构的优先事项，通过改善……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出两种利用同一试验中亚组外参与者信息的目标最大似然估计量（TMLE-PR与A-TMLE），在不依赖外部真实世界数据的前提下，提高随机对照试验中亚组分析的统计效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two TMLEs (TMLE-PR and A-TMLE) that borrow information from non-subgroup participants within the same trial, improving the statistical efficiency of subgroup analyses in randomized controlled trials without relying on any external real-world data.
